manifest.description: Diagnose data-access amplification: repeated per-row DB/RPC fetches where batching or eager loading should exist (n+1), and query patterns whose evidence suggests a missing covering index.
when_to_use: a loop body issues a DB query or RPC per element where one batched call would do
an ORM/association access inside an iteration triggers a fetch per row
a query log or operator hint shows a request issuing many near-identical queries
query evidence suggests a full scan or missing covering index for a hot lookup
anti_patterns: do not flag a per-element call that genuinely must be independent (distinct keys with no batch API)
do not assert a missing index without query evidence — that is a database-design hypothesis, not a code smell
do not propose eager loading that changes transactional or consistency semantics without saying so
do not use for a fetch that runs once outside any loop
